made: 2026-11-07, from each chapter's own section headings (https://ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/jesc1NN.pdf)

beaker.name: Beaker bench
beaker.adds_here: spirit-lamp heating, electrolysis cell, pH meter with universal indicator, gas tests (pop test, lime water)

optics.name: Optics bench
optics.what: Place a candle, mirror, lens, slab or prism on a rail; drag the object; rays and the image are drawn from the real formulas (mirror and lens formula, Snell's law); eye mode for the human eye and its defects

circuit.name: Circuit builder
circuit.what: Drag cells, bulbs, resistors, keys, ammeter and voltmeter onto a board and wire them; readings from Ohm's law; series and parallel; power and energy; a house wiring mode with fuse, MCB and earth

field.name: Magnetic field
field.what: Iron filings and compasses around a bar magnet, a straight wire, a loop and a solenoid; switch the current and reverse it; Fleming's left-hand rule on a wire in a field

molecule.name: Molecule builder
molecule.what: Build molecules from atoms with electron-dot and ball-and-stick views; covalent and ionic bonding; carbon chains, rings, double and triple bonds; names from the structure

body.name: Body explorer
body.what: Turn and open organ systems in layers (from the 3DM images); animate the path of food, air, blood, urine and a nerve signal; tap a part for its name and job

scope.name: Microscope
scope.what: Choose a slide, focus and zoom; stomata opening, yeast budding, amoeba dividing, spores; draw-what-you-see check

cross.name: Genetics cross
cross.what: Pick parent pea plants, cross them, fill the Punnett square, grow the offspring and count the ratio; one trait and two traits; XX and XY

eco.name: Ecosystem
eco.what: Build a food chain and a food web from organism cards; watch energy pass up (10 per cent rule); sort waste into biodegradable and non-biodegradable

sort.name: Sort and classify
sort.what: Drag cards into labelled bins with instant explanations; used across subjects (reaction types, metals and non-metals, acids and bases)
